title: Audio in the prompt box: Sound & Music and Text to Speech become prompt-box models, leave the Flow Library
description: Fabio 2026-10-02, a 2.0 gate under MPI-595: the prompt box has no audio models. Sound & Music (Stable Audio 3: prompt, category, length, no inputs) and Text to Speech (Chatterbox: the line, one voice sample, language) are too simple to be Flows and move into the prompt box as audio models; both leave the Flow Library. Voice Changer STAYS a Flow (its result depends on how you record - the measured coaching is the Flow's job). Same weights and nodes, so the v0.24.0 Pod image is unaffected. Traps: Stable Audio's licence gate is keyed on flow:sound-and-music and misses SILENTLY if not moved; old cards, saved Routines and Cosmo's Flow knowledge name the two Flow ops; the new models need smoke evidence, folded into MPI-595 item 2's paid re-smoke.
